new: In April 2026 the National Assembly elected General Secretary To Lam as State President too (495 of 495 votes), echoing China’s model. It was not the first time: Nguyen Phu Trong held both posts in 2018–21, and To Lam himself briefly in 2024.
problem: Omits that the party chief has held the presidency twice before (Nguyen Phu Trong 2018–21; To Lam Aug–Oct 2024), so the 2026 merger is presented as more unprecedented than it is.
